title: Lantern Walks in Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **St. Martin's Day is Wednesday 11 November**, and Berlin's public lantern walks run from the 11th to Saturday the 14th. None of the ten with a confirmed 2026 date asks for a ticket or a booking.

**Wednesday 11 November is the big evening:** the Berliner Dom play at 17:00 with a walk round the Lustgarten, three walks to the Jahn-Sportpark in Prenzlauer Berg, and walks in Pankow, Spandau, Marzahn and Adlershof.
**The weekend-friendly two:** Lichtenberg on **Friday 13 November at 16:00** from Freiaplatz, and the **Domäne Dahlem** farm on **Saturday 14 November at 17:00**.
**Sunset on 11 November is 16:19**, dark by about 16:56, which is why most walks start between 16:00 and 17:30.
**Thirteen more walks ran in 2024 or 2025** but had no 2026 date on 22 October, including Kreuzberg's bagpipe walk, the ufaFabrik farm and Lübars. Check their own pages before you go.
**My move:** put the one walk that fits your week in the calendar now, and pack a spare battery for the lantern stick and a cup for the punch.
